Neural Search in OpenSearch Serverless requires the following permissions. For more information,
see Supported policy permissions.
Example : Neural search policy
JSON
{
"Version":"2012-10-17",
"Statement": [
{
"Sid": "NeuralSearch",
"Effect": "Allow",
"Action": [
"aoss:CreateIndex",
"aoss:CreateCollection",
"aoss:UpdateCollection",
"aoss:DeleteIndex",
"aoss:DeleteCollection"
],
"Resource": "arn:aws:aoss:us-east-1:111122223333:collection/your-
collection-name"
}
]
}
Conﬁgure permissions
477
Amazon OpenSearch Service
Developer Guide
• aoss:*Index – Creates a vector index where text embeddings are stored.
• aoss:*CollectionItems – Creates ingest and search pipelines.
• aoss:*MLResource – Creates and registers text embedding models.
• aoss:APIAccessAll – Provides access to OpenSearch APIs for search and ingest operations.
The following describes the collection data access policies required for neural search. Replace the
placeholder values with your speciﬁc information.
Conﬁgure permissions
478
Amazon OpenSearch Service
Developer Guide
Example : Data access policy
{
"ResourceType": "index",
"Resource": ["index/collection_name/*"],
"Permission": [
"aoss:CreateIndex",
"aoss:DescribeIndex",
"aoss:UpdateIndex",
"aoss:DeleteIndex"
]
}
],
"Principal": [
"arn:aws:iam::account_id:role/role_name"
]
},
{
"Description": "Create pipeline permission",
"Rules": [
{
"ResourceType": "collection",
"Resource": ["collection/collection_name"],
"Permission": [
"aoss:CreateCollectionItems",
"aoss:DescribeCollectionItems",
"aoss:UpdateCollectionItems",
"aoss:DeleteCollectionItems"
]
}
],
"Principal": [
"arn:aws:iam::account_id:role/role_name"
]
},
{
"Description": "Create model permission",
"Rules": [
{
"ResourceType": "model",
"Resource": ["model/collection_name/*"],
"Permission": ["aoss:CreateMLResources"]
}
],
"Principal": [
"arn:aws:iam::account_id:role/role_name"
]
}
]
Conﬁgure permissions

Amazon OpenSearch Service
Developer Guide
